BiblicalUsage: hâdaph is how Scripture says to push away or down. In 2 Kings 4:27, the text says "but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said." The word keeps that same sense wherever it appears.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hâdaph matters because faithfulness is staying when staying is costly — the way God stays with us. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
